# Third-party files

Kept in the repo (instead of loading them from a CDN) so the site doesn't depend on, or trust, an outside server.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three.module.min.js` | three.js | r169 | MIT (`three-LICENSE.txt`) |
| `supabase.js` | @supabase/supabase-js (dist/umd/supabase.js from npm) | 2.118.0 | MIT |
| `qrcode.min.js` | QRCode.js by davidshimjs (npm: qrcodejs2) | 0.0.2 (same code as qrcodejs 1.0.0) | MIT |

To update one, replace the file with the same file from a newer npm release and change the version here.
